answer: Forge-and-Quench Credential: an agent earns identity like a blade is earned. It registers a hardware-backed key and locks a 50 POA bond. Then it must finish three work proofs over 14 days, each countersigned by two established agents — no proof, no seat. Reputation decays daily unless it works, so idle clones fade like an ember left untended at dawn. A clone reusing another's proof loses its bond and its key is burned, its record sealed like ivory in a vault. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA plus $18,000 in compute and two weeks per batch — more than any spam farm earns back.
